title: Wow
body: I am very impressed of this app! It is like a rare gem. Possibilities to customize it are really spot on, but it still keeps it very easy, fast and rewarding to use! You can easily track ADHD medicine impact and timing, weight loss, eating, symptoms etc. And in a level YOU want. I personally don’t want to track every little thing I eat, so I can just mark by rough overall amount if I wish. This app is worth the yearly cost and I hope it won’t be increased so many people would have a change of using this. UX and UI is also good. Well done developer, thank you ❤️
author: Just me trying to count

title: Un-bearable notifications and emails.
body: To be fair, the app is layers out well and seems good. My biggest criticism is that the symptoms are for the whole day, not different times of the day. My energy and pain levels change throughout the day, so this didn’t suit me. But, holy moly! The amount of repeat notifications and emails every day was just too much. Yea, I can turn stuff off but when you are chronically ill, with very little energy, it’s too much to deal with.
author: Vitrioleater

title: Marvellous
body: I have been a proud and loyal user for over four years, and the new ‘Impacts’ feature is absolutely amazing. 😃
